name: Garmi
summary: Tigmanshu Dhulia captures the fiery emotions and the harsh world of college politics in the political drama series Garmi. From a small-town dreamer to a student leader, a young man's life takes a 180-degree turn when he steps into the murky world of college politics, power and crime. Will he succumb or rise above it all to achieve his ultimate goal?

name: Dogs 4 Life
summary: In this series, David Campbell has teamed up with VitaPet to uncover how dogs have an incredible ability to make us better humans. It's an emotional connection that's universal.

name: Pet Puraan
summary: Even after years of being married to each other, Atul and Aditi are still confused about whether or not to become parents. Friends and relatives urge them to take the next step toward parenthood, but the couple is not convinced. However, everything changes for this 'in-denial' married couple when they foster a pregnant cat that lands on their doorstep, leading them to decide to take on an exciting yet challenging phase of life - Pet Parenting!

name: 36 Days
summary: An enigmatic woman's arrival in a seemingly idyllic housing estate in Goa threatens to expose the residents' darkest secrets. As they clamour to unravel her mysteries, all their lies and hidden identities begin destroying them, culminating in absolute horror.

name: Versus
summary: Entertainment program where viewers and participants in the studio fight to predict the outcome of spectacular duels.

name: Sommerdrømme
summary: Sun, summer and community - four couples create their dream summer house.

name: G-Force: Guardians of Space
summary: A bird-themed superhero team battles the threat of Galactor and his minions, an international terrorist organization with advanced technology.

name: Música Boa Ao Vivo
summary: The program welcomes big names in Brazilian music for an incredible meeting, full of hits, surprises and unprecedented musical partnerships.

name: En vej ud
summary: Who will crack the code and find their way out first? Anything can happen when the hosts lock a number of well-known Danes into escape rooms, where they must compete against each other in pairs.

name: Bachelorette
summary: Romance, drama and lots of dates! Everything is on the line when Danish single women search for true love among a group of hopeful men. Each season offers new adventures for the 'Bachelorette' contestants.

name: De arktiske reddere
summary: For a year, DR has closely followed the Arctic rescue team in Greenland, and we are involved in the spectacular missions in the Search-and-Rescue helicopter in Kangerlussuaq.

name: Er der nogen?
summary: Mikkel Egelund, Trine Gadeberg and Kasper Le Fevre is trying to find evidence that manor houses and castles are haunted. The ghost hunters investigate legends, myths and history, as well as spend a night at the location to document whether there is anyone in the dark.

name: Kinnikuman Perfect Origin Arc
summary: Kinnikuman returns to the ring in an epic three-way battle between the Justice, Devil and Perfect Chojin factions, and reveals the roots of the Chojin.

name: Jimmy Kimmel Live: Game Night
summary: Jimmy Kimmel Live: Game Night is a series of half-hour primetime specials that air immediately before each game of the NBA FINALS (or immediately after each game on the West Coast). The format is the same as his late night show, and his celebrity guest list is impressive since the summer movie season is in full swing.

name: The Demolition Man
summary: Host Brendan Moar dives into the process of what it takes to bring down some of the biggest structures from around the world.

name: The Faceless Lady
summary: Step inside Kilolc castle, a magnificent stone fortress deep in the Irish countryside and home to the infamous 'Faceless Lady', a tragic spirit doomed to walk the crumbling manor for eternity. But her story is far from over, as three young couples are about to discover. Drawn to the castle by its mysterious owner, they have come to compete in historic Games. The winner shall inherit Kilolc Castle, and all that lies within it… both the living, and the dead.

name: Agora é Tarde
summary: In late now, Danilo Gentili promises to combine humor and commentary on the news of the day without the acidity of the interviews he does with politicians in CQC. The word most often used to define the attraction was entertainment: This is the program we would like to attend.

name: The Big Match
summary: Usually screened on a Sunday afternoon and was ITV's answer to BBC's Match of the Day, it showed highlights of usually 3 football matches played on the day before.

name: Match Game PM
summary: A group of celebrities would be given a sentence with a missing word, which they would then have to fill in. The contestants would then give their own answer, and scored points according to how many celebrities gave the same answer.

name: Match Game
summary: Two contestants attempt to match their comedy answers to a series of questions with the answers given by a panel of six Hollywood celebrities.

name: Kriegsschiffe - Tod auf See
summary: Describes the development of maritime shipbuilding since the end of the 19th century. With the invention of the steam engine and the implementation of machine-assisted propulsion for ships, warfare at sea had radically changed. Ever new improvements that go hand in hand with the rapid development of war weapons have led to the arms race of various nations since the First World War at the latest. Today aircraft carriers, nuclear submarines, destroyers and other classes of ships are an integral part of global power politics. The documentary series shows famous sea battles of history and shows the influence ships have had in the war politics of different nations.

name: Gunaah
summary: Betrayed by loved ones, the world around Shiva shattered! Taking a new identity as Abhimanyu, he endures many trials for a bloody vengeance, carved with love.

name: The Motorway Hotel
summary:
Welcome to The Motorway Hotel, a family-run business yards from the M6 in Staffordshire, catering to commuters, motorists, locals and road workers alike.

Juggling 41 rooms, a wedding business, restaurant and bar, there's never a dull moment for the Lewis clan who own and run the hotel and a team of staff, some of whom have been there for decades. With Britain's longest motorway thundering past the door and all the stresses and strains of running a busy hotel, watch the drama unfold as the team tries to keep the Motorway Hotel running in a straight line.

Hotel bosses Chris Lewis and his wife Dawn have recently handed over control of the Motorway Hotel to their daughter Emily. But Chris is having trouble stepping back, which is causing ripples…

name: Star Kitchen mit Tim Raue
summary: In the 6-part food reality series, renowned 2-star chef Tim Raue accompanies aspiring young cooks on their turbulent path to their first or next Michelin star. The series delves into the fascinating world of Michelin-starred cuisine and particularly sheds light on the cooks' personal life paths with their goal of earning one or more stars.

name: Maharana
summary: Fighting against all odds for his motherland, this fearless ruler created history. Watch the saga of Maharana Pratap's exemplary courage.

name: Gyaarah Gyaarah
summary: Three cops defy the rules of time to investigate and deliver justice in a series of cold cases. How far will they go as they work from within the corrupt system to bring the criminals to book?

name: D-Day 80
summary: Paying tribute to the heroes of 1944. Poignant and powerful events on both sides of the Channel to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the D-Day landings.

name: Nick Knowles in South America
summary:
Intrepid Nick Knowles sets off on another ambitious adventure for Channel 5, this time to South America.

From the self-styled ‘end of the world' in Chile, Nick treks to the astonishing Torres del Paine National Park, considered by some to be the eighth wonder of the world. From the lake district, he visits a Chilean archipelago in the Pacific and its largest island Chiloe, home of witches, and finally traverses the Andes to end his South American odyssey in Argentina.

name: Wild, Smart and Deadly
summary: Wild, Smart, and Deadly features the planet's most extraordinary animals as they deploy a range of astonishing, secret superpowers to vanquish their enemies, hunt down prey, attract a mate and survive in the wild.

name: Biography: Rock Legends
summary: A&E offers viewers a backstage pass to the celebrated careers of some of hard rock's greatest legends with new specials celebrating rock icons Bret Michaels, Twisted Sister's Dee Snider, Alice Cooper, Sammy Hagar, and Sebastian Bach. Produced by Banger Films in association with A+E Factual Studios group under the award-winning Biography banner, the specials will feature exclusive interviews with each of the artists and those closest to them. Beginning Sunday, June 16 at 9pm ET, the nostalgia inducing specials will go behind-the-scenes to the artists' journeys to fame, legendary careers, and iconic music that defined the genre then and now.

name: Tarot
summary: A brutal fate mystery series that tells the story of being trapped in the curse of tarot cards twisted by a moment's choice.

previousepisode.name: Card 7: The Lovers - Storage box for 1 person

name: Scandal
summary: A fierce, passionate battle begins between a woman who wants it all and a woman who risks it all for revenge.

name: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
summary: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is considered the idol of her institute. She has conquered the hearts of countless male students and is admired by everyone else, but everyone distrusts this almost perfect girl.

name: Cheran's Journey
summary: Five equally talented candidates. One vacancy. Having journeyed through trying times in their lives, each of them must prove why they deserve the job. Can they rely on their past to help build their future?

name: Saturday Night Politics with Donny Deutsch
summary: Donny Deutsch delivers the latest political developments from the week and features one-on-one interviews with politicians and news makers.

name: Ness Murby: Transcending
summary: This six-part documentary series follows groundbreaking Paralympian Ness Murby as he trains and vies to become the world's first openly trans man to compete at a Paralympic Games.

name: Rio-Paris: A Tragédia do Voo 447
summary: A plane disappears from radar during a Rio-Paris flight. Family members, researchers and experts recount, 15 years later, one of the greatest tragedies in the history of aviation.

name: Gypsy Rose: Life After Lock Up
summary: This series is an authentic, raw and revealing look at Gypsy's new life on the outside. From the joyful moments as she is free to make her own decisions for the first time, to the challenges of navigating life and relationships while facing her past, including the abuse she suffered at the hands of her mother, and Gypsy's own notoriety and fame. In this delayed-coming-of-age story, Gypsy must reconcile the pop-culture, celebrity version of herself while trying to forge her brand-new identity in a "normal" world as wife, sister, daughter and most of all – a free woman.

name: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
summary: The story of the tug of war between Marvel and Sony and how two studios found a way to share the character and the profits. Spider-man's journey to the screen overcomes bankruptcy, multiple lawsuits, reboots, and unrealized potential.

name: Like a Dragon: Yakuza
summary: Set in the fictional town of Kamurocho, the story unfolds across two intersecting timelines—1995 and 2005. In 1995, four friends eager to escape their restrictive lives in an orphanage dive into the yakuza-controlled underworld of 1995 Kamurocho. Meanwhile, in 2005, their friendship is deteriorated, as tensions between the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance are at a boiling point.

name: Грязные Мысли
summary: "Gryaznyye Mysli" is the first media intellectual championship from ClickKlak and VK Video. Here you will see how the 8 best teams, who passed an incredibly difficult selection, will compete for the title of champion of the first season. By answering correctly, the team earns points. But if the answers are incorrect, then a bucket of dirt will turn over on the participants!

previousepisode.name: Финал. Зубы Васильева vs. 2 Белоснежки и скуф

name: Pavilion Secrets
summary: The feared General Yun Shu, known as the "King of Hell," encounters Song Huanbei, who approaches her under the guise of a male companion. Song Huanbei, the leader of the top intelligence agency in the martial world, is determined to find the culprits behind the Mo family's massacre. Meanwhile, Yun Shu, who is actually a Mo family survivor disguised as a man, gradually falls in love with him as they test each other's motives.

name: Варшава'21
summary: During the election race for the presidency of Poland, the famous journalist Kozelski is cynically killed. Polish TV channels immediately pick up the version about Russia's interference in the country's internal affairs in order to support Silesian separatists and destabilize the situation. As proof, an audio recording of a conversation between Russian Ambassador Konobeev and one of the presidential candidates Dombrovsky is being played on TV, which was allegedly sent from the murdered journalist's mail. From a small spark, a geopolitical conflagration is fanning, capable of causing enormous damage to the interests of the country. The compromised employee of the diplomatic mission ends up in the hospital with a heart attack, and crisis diplomat Vyacheslav Vasiliev arrives in his place. He will have to prove that the accusations against Moscow have no basis in fact.

name: Mom, I'm Sorry
summary: To save his terminally ill mother, Dong Cui Can makes a deal with a mysterious stranger, exchanging his remaining years for hers. Miraculously, the stranger not only revives Cui Can's mother but also restores her to her 20-year-old self. With a second chance at life, Yan Jin Yu is determined to seize every moment, while Cui Can vows to spend the rest of his days repaying his mother for the sacrifices she made to raise him.

name: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
summary: Social Media Influencers seem to have it all — money, celebrity, power. But in these shocking true crime stories, there is a horrifying dark side to the fame, which reveals how these online dreams can quickly become blood-soaked nightmares.

name: Smith & Smith
summary: Smith & Smith is a Canadian sketch comedy series, which aired from 1979 to 1985 on Hamilton, Ontario's CHCH-TV, and through syndication on other Canadian television stations. The show starred the husband and wife comedy duo of Steve Smith and Morag Smith. The show took a one-year hiatus in 1985, during which the Smiths and their children Max and David starred in the family sitcom Me & Max. After that show ended its run, Steve and Morag revived Smith & Smith under the new title The Comedy Mill. In 1991, Morag retired from performing and Steve launched his most famous series, The Red Green Show. Red Green was originally created as a recurring character on Smith & Smith. Each show also included a humorous musical number, performed in costume, focusing on a famous couple in history, as well as a mailbag segment. The latter was retained in The Red Green Show, albeit in less earnest form.

name: Northern Air Rescue
summary: Born from the need to transport patients and people from Indigenous communities in Canada, Northern Air Rescue documents life inside Mississippi Airways, a Manitoba airline providing air ambulance, passenger and cargo services to the north.

name: The Comedy Mill
summary:
The Comedy Mill was a Canadian sketch comedy television series, which aired from 1987 to 1991 on Hamilton, Ontario's CHCH-TV, and through syndication on other Canadian television stations. The show starred the husband and wife comedy duo of Steve Smith and Morag Smith, with a supporting cast that included Peter Keleghan, Linda Kash and Mag Ruffman.

The show was a revival of their earlier Smith & Smith series, which ended in 1985. For the 85-86 television season, the Smiths and their children Max and David starred in the family sitcom Me & Max.

One of the show's regular features involved parody music videos, presented by Kash as a caricature of a television VJ. Some of the parody videos even made it into rotation on MuchMusic and The Nashville Network.

After The Comedy Mill ended its run, Morag retired from performing and Steve launched his most famous series, The Red Green Show. Red Green had appeared as a recurring character on all of the duo's earlier shows, including The Comedy Mill.

name: Me & Max
summary:
Me & Max was a situation comedy produced for Canadian television station CHCH-TV in 1985.

Evolving out of the sketch comedy series Smith & Smith, Me & Max starred husband-and-wife comedy team Steve Smith and Morag Smith, and their kids Max and David. All four members of the Smith family played fictionalized versions of themselves, and Steve and Morag also played other characters, such as the neighbours and the boys' uncle Red Green, through split-screen photography.

The series lasted for 26 episodes, at which time Steve and Morag Smith went on to produce another sketch comedy series, The Comedy Mill. Following the end of that show's run, Steve Smith developed another series, The Red Green Show. The character of Red Green had appeared in all of the Smiths' previous shows, including Me & Max.

name: Shaka iLembe
summary: Explores the story of the making of the iconic African king, from his childhood through to adulthood, during the 1700s.

name: 1122: For a Happy Marriage
summary: Wife: Ichiko Aihara. Husband: Otoya Aihara. Married for seven years, they get along well, but sexless and without children, they agree to see other people. Otoya has an affair with Mitsuki, and Ichiko is aware of it. Looking at Otoya in a state of bliss with Mitsuki, Ichiko begins to change, too.

name: Yuzuki-san Chi no Yon-Kyodai
summary: Family is everything. The four Yuzuki brothers lost their parents two years ago, and now work to raise themselves. Hayato, the eldest, then Mikoto, Minato, and young Gakuto. Hayato works and provides for the family. Mikoto is relaxed and calm. Minato is full of energy, and Gakuto is wise beyond his years. Together they live, learn, fight, and forgive as brothers should. Meet the Yuzuki family!

name: Dette er humor
summary: We love to laugh at them, but what are they laughing at themselves? Norway's greatest humorists share their funniest and most boring humor memories.

name: EM i hageleker
summary: Traditional garden games get a twist and extra competition when six celebrities go into the most important competition of their lives. Forget the Olympics and European Championships in football. We choose a champion in garden games.

name: Oppdrag Europa
summary: Mikkel and Herman solve assignments in some of Europe's least visited countries. On the way, they take part in a soap opera, tackle a spitting llama and meet baby Hitler!

name: Våre beste år
summary: A Raddis family moves to the west end in the mid-80s and gets the Yapp era in the middle of their face. Son Ole Martin is transformed into a petty materialist, while daughter Simone is taken by the political right-wing wave. At the same time, mum Siri is fighting a desperate battle to stop the Americanization of the youth program she works on at NRK.

name: Her lukter det fesk
summary: Fishing geek and musician Bilal Saab takes other artists on adventurous fishing trips with impressive catches, beautiful music - and wild nature.

name: Allen Jackson NOW
summary:
Television is filled with dysfunction, and the world is drowning in it. Negativity has saturated people of all ages, fed by competition to the bottom on social media.

What if someone new came along with a fresh operating principle? A person who has traveled the world, seen the worst of it but deals strictly with how to move forward. An honest and inspiring leader who has lived the full Christian life as a pastor and uses his wisdom to inspire others. Meet Allen Jackson.

Allen cannot be compared to anyone in the current media market because the business has not showcased anyone like him. Allen Jackson NOW is a lifeline for a struggling and anxious nation. A guiding hand for those who are not ready to give up, and for those who want to find a way past the negativity--before things get worse.

Americans still have hope, they are searching for the wisdom embedded in a Christian worldview. Allen Jackson will be that missing link for a nation unhinged.

name: Bangkok Khanika
summary: Three women, a sex worker with big dreams, a girl seeking love, and another sold into the trade, fight to liberate themselves and reclaim their dignity.

name: Disko 76
summary: In 1976, the disco wave spread to Bochum: an overwhelming desire for freedom meets stuffy conventions, disco beats meet solid hits, glamor meets coal dust. Disco fever is also rampant among Doro and her siblings, who want more from life than to live up to their parents' expectations: in the light of the disco ball they can be young, rebellious and wild, live in the moment, turn night into day, fly high and fall low.

name: ROCHE PE
summary: ROCHE PE is a non-profit University Project, born from a group of university students and fans of the original SKAM series who decided that Peru needs a real and honest representation of youth in the XXI century.

name: Une Amie Dévouée
summary: Inspired by true events, this psychological thriller follows Christelle "Chris" Blandin, a rock music-obsessed Parisian, who, after witnessing the harrowing November 13, 2015 terrorist attacks, quickly latches onto a community of survivors. Claiming that her best friend Vincent was one of dozens critically injured at the Bataclan Theatre, Chris becomes an indispensable resource for the group, working her way into a prominent role in a survivors' association. Though her commitment seems relentless, discrepancies begin to pepper her story – raising serious doubts among the true victims of the tragedy.

name: F1: The Academy
summary: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

name: The Creep Tapes
summary: The Creep Tapes is a collection of video tapes from the secret vault of the world's deadliest and most socially uncomfortable serial killer. Unravel a twisted mind as he lures victims to film his life, only to reveal his deadly intentions.

name: The Baldwins
summary: The Baldwins offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look into the lives of Alec and Hilaria Baldwin and their seven children. This series blends the highs and lows of family life, with the challenges and humor that come while raising a large family in the public eye.

name: Shameless Lover
summary: Shen Zhili seeks a rare herb to revive her master using an ancient remedy, but Su Chenche's arrival pulls her into a time loop. Shen discovers that whenever Su dies, time rewinds. To successfully find the herb, they set out together, facing both harmony and misunderstandings, with a mysterious figure guiding them from the shadows. Can they solve the mystery of time and find the elusive herb?

name: A Life for a Life
summary: In the 1980s, the top student of the police academy, Du Xiang Dong, was assigned against his wishes to a detention center. Two suspects escaped from the jail; one died, and the other got away. Du Xiang Dong blamed himself and impulsively resigned. For the next twenty years, he found himself in a battle of wits with the escaped suspect, Xu Wen Geng. Both followed their own ways of life, engaging in a strategic duel amidst the tides of the times.

name: The Art of...
summary: This show is on a mission: to answer life's big questions through art. Join the ever-curious Namila Benson on the journey as she meets artists from all over the creative landscape to find out who we are and where we're headed.

name: Prince Charming
summary: Jacek Jelonek, the title Prince Charming, is looking for his dream partner among 13 singles in a villa in sunny Spain. For the first time in Poland, there is such a breakthrough program in which love between two men is finally on an equal footing.

name: 99 to Beat
summary: 99 to Beat is the game show that anyone can win, but there's one rule players must follow if they're to be in with a chance of walking away with the cash prize – Don't. Come. Last. As contestants battle it out against each other, each round will see the number of players whittled down until one person takes the top prize.

name: The Boyfriend
summary: Single men from diverse backgrounds gather in a sunny ocean-side house to live and work together for one summer – will romance brew or end bittersweet?

previousepisode.name: Will You Be My First Boyfriend?

name: D-Day: 100 Days to Beat the Third Reich
summary: retracing day by day, the key moment of the Second World War, through a series of moving testimonies and spectacular colorized archives, both collective and intimate.

name: Brat Pack Vs.
summary: Watch as the Brat Pack goes head-to-head with your favorite creators in a series of awe-inspiring challenges. The winners take home a prize, and the losers get... dunked!

previousepisode.name: Does The Brat Pack Know Olivia Rodrigo?

name: Chasing Beauty
summary: We follow 9 young women and men who choose to give mother nature a helping hand. They are dissatisfied with some aspect of their body and the series follows them through the process. Will the plastic or cosmetic procedures help them feel better?

name: Prime News
summary: ''Prime News" delivers comprehensive analysis and commentary covering the latest national and international news.

name: Good Afternoon Britain
summary: Tackling the big stories from all angles and perspectives. Weekdays from midday, Tom Harwood and Emily Carver bring you the most compelling stories from across the United Kingdom.

name: Martin Daubney
summary: Join Martin for an up-to-the-minute take on the day's events delivered in his own unique and lively style.

name: Vote 2024: The People Decide
summary: Complete coverage of the general election campaign. All the twists and turns as parties try to win your vote and the keys to Number 10.

name: Jacob Rees-Mogg's State Of The Nation
summary: Join Jacob for his unique and unmissable take on the day's news.

name: Patrick Christys Tonight
summary: Join Patrick for two hours of spirited debate and news making interviews. Top guests tackle the issues that matter, with a sharp take on every story.

name: Breakfast with Stephen and Ellie
summary: Join Stephen Dixon and Ellie Costello to start your day across the United Kingdom. This is your breakfast show. Join the conversation about what is happening in our nation and the world.

name: Friday Night Live with Mark Dolan
summary: Join Mark for the biggest stories and debates of the week with a panel of top politicians, comedians and commentators.

name: Saturday Morning Live
summary: Join Ellie Costello and Ben Leo for a fun and friendly look at the news with debates on the topics that really matter to you.

name: GB News Saturday
summary: A pacey look at all the latest live and breaking news for the weekend from around the UK with our network of GB News reporters, plus views and debate from a wide range of perspectives.

name: The Saturday Five
summary: Join our provocative panel to discuss and debate the spikiest stories and craziest controversies of the week.

name: The Saturday Night Showdown
summary: Politicians, comedians and celebrities explore the big stories of the week to find the funny in the issues that matter to you.

name: The Camilla Tominey Show
summary: Join Camilla Tominey for a Sunday morning politics show with personality, live from Westminster.

name: GB News Sunday
summary: A pacey look at all the latest live and breaking news for the weekend from around the UK with our network of GB News reporters, plus views and debate from a wide range of perspectives.

name: The Context
summary: Presented by Christian Fraser. A regular panel of guests from across the political spectrum discuss the biggest international stories of the day.

name: Electioncast
summary: Watch Newscast every day during the UK general election.

name: Ye Se Jiang Ming
summary: Ai Lin, who had been blind for many years, unexpectedly regained her sight. She was excited and wanted to share the news with her husband, but she didn't expect to see him and the nanny making love in the living room. It turned out that her husband and the nanny had been sleeping secretly under her nose for a long time. Feeling angry and ashamed, Ai Lin decided to pretend to be blind and started playing mind games with them, so that her husband and nanny could experience the feeling of being fooled. In this way, both of them, became confused and suspicious of each other. But feeling that she already completed her revenge, she then decided to leave with her son. But what she never expected was that when the child came back from summer camp, she found that the "son" in front of her was not her own child! Ai Lin rushed to the police station like crazy to ask for help, but she didn't expect that she will meet there her husband stating that Ai Lin, lost her mind. Confused by all of this she starts to connect the facts, and tries to determine what is the truth and what is an illusion in her life.

name: Du Gei Jun De Tishen Yahuan
J'adore le jus
summary: "J'adore le jus" tells the scandalous story between Mathieu Mailloux, a teenage entrepreneur, and ZOOP organic energy drinks. Under a backdrop of caffeine, this epic plunges us into the most terrible secrets of a large Quebec company.

name: Tell Me Everything
summary:
A brutal sexual assault in a locked hotel room leaves one woman and her husband, Kobi, broken and forced to move on with their lives without any answers. The two police investigators – Avi Avraham and Orna Denis – have few leads to go on – and completely different theories about how to pursue the investigation.

Kobi cannot accept the fact that they'll likely never know who attacked his wife. When the police tell him yet again to "be patient", he decides to take matters into his own hands, going rogue and conducting his own private inquiries in parallel to the official investigation.

When another woman is assaulted in the same hotel chain, the race to catch the perpetrator heats up, with both Kobi and the investigators in pursuit of the truth and justice – with tragic results.

name: Атом
summary:
The year is 1943. Beria instructs his deputy Vsevolod Zamyatin to assemble a team of scientists to design the first Soviet atomic bomb. To do this in the midst of a war and in a short time is an almost impossible task. 

Under Kurchatov's leadership, secret Laboratory No. 2 begins work in Moscow, where the best minds from all over the Union become employees. Kurchatov convinces Zamyatin to include two scientists in the project: the audacious and self-confident Frolov, who had previously discovered spontaneous nuclear fission, and the radiochemist Karpova, who is in exile in Kazakhstan. And although Frolov and Karpova raise questions in the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs, it was decided to fulfill Kurchatov's request. At the same time, Soviet intelligence is working to obtain the scientific information necessary for the project abroad. Agent Ekaterina Lazareva, a former physicist and Frolov's lover, manages to transfer the most important data about the Allied atomic project to the USSR. From now on, the Soviet Union needs to catch up with Britain and the United States in order to achieve nuclear equilibrium in the post-war world.

name: Разящий луч
summary:
The KGB of the USSR is alarmed by the CIA's attempts to penetrate the secrets of the laboratory of Nobel laureate Nikolai Baskov, which develops lasers for missile defense. KGB Colonel Valentin Simagin recruits Kim Nikanorov, a former laboratory employee turned currency speculator. It should become a channel of disinformation for Americans about the activities of the laboratory. Kim is arranged to work for Basov again and helps him establish contacts with a CIA resident.

 Everything goes according to the KGB's plan, but soon Kim is faced with a very experienced and sophisticated opponent — a CIA agent with the call sign Leonardo. She suspects that Kim is a figurehead for the KGB.

name: Хирург
summary: Behind the facade of the prestigious clinic there is a landfill for illegal organ transplant operations. Many find themselves drawn into the criminal world of underground transplantation — some of their own free will, others not. A successful surgeon who compromises with his conscience in order to finance ambitious scientific research. A simple graduate student who happened to be next to him and was trying to save a loved one. A crazy journalist who had nothing to lose after a fatal diagnosis — now only a transplant can save her, but officially you can't wait for your turn. Everyone is immersed in the hidden world of organ trafficking, illegal migrants and clandestine surgery. Everyone has their own story and their own aspirations. But they all find themselves hostage to circumstances in which it is impossible to remain human, it remains only to choose who to be — a predator or a victim.

name: Всё сложно
summary: The serene life of 40-year-old Katya collapsed in one day. The husband was found dead with his mistress, his illegitimate teenage daughter fell on his head, collectors took away the house. The only way out is to get married again, for which Katya starts an account in the Dating app. The wildest situations are waiting for her ahead — funny, dangerous, absurd, sentimental or tragic, and she will get out of each with a new experience.

name: Baddies Caribbean
summary: The Baddies head to the Caribbean where they plan on creating more of a storm than a Hurricane.

name: Pop Star Academy: KATSEYE
summary: Pop Star Academy: KATSEYE follows 20 contestants from around the world over a year-long journey as they compete to become KATSEYE, a one-of-a-kind global girl group formed using KPOP methodologies. With unprecedented access, unfolding over eight episodes, the result is a compelling portrayal of the road to international stardom, including insight into the unique training and development program developed by HYBE and Geffen Records.

name: Destruction Decoded
summary:
Exploring life-altering, earth-shattering events through archive footage, CGI, and informative scripting. Delves into the science behind each event, shedding light on fascinating elements and providing an understanding of their occurrence.

Created by Big Media. Available Languages: English, French, Spanish. Sold to over 25 countries worldwide. "Broadcast" on many global, national/regional services: subscription, TV Linked & Free.

name: Izzy Does It
summary: Izzy Does It follows Izzy and his family as they grow their home renovation and design business and navigate working together in his hometown of Santa Ana, California. Together they will deliver dazzling renovation results to clients with realistic budgets.

name: Countdown
summary: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.

name: The Man with 1000 Kids
summary: The Man With 1000 Kids uncovers the gripping tale of a charming Dutch scammer, Jonathan Meijer, who is accused of travelling the world deceiving mothers into having his babies on a mass scale. The three-part series investigates the murky world of the fertility industry and uncovers how due to a lack of global regulations, some international fertility clinics continue to allow anonymous donations.

name: Simone Biles Rising
summary: Follow gymnast Simone Biles as she balances her personal life, mental health journey and training ahead of a highly anticipated return to the Olympics.

name: SPRINT
summary: Elite sprinters navigate training, media scrutiny and fierce competition in this sports series following their race to become the world's fastest humans.

name: Dirty Pop: The Boy Band Scam
summary: Members of NSYNC, Backstreet Boys and O-Town reflect on their rise to stardom under a notorious talent manager in this hard-hitting docuseries.

name: Wyatt Earp and the Cowboy War
summary: The true story of Wyatt Earp, his legendary Vendetta Ride, and how his famed gunfight at the OK Corral gained national and international attention that nearly sparked a second Civil War.

name: Prime News with Jenn Pellegrino
summary: Prime News with Jenn Pellegrino delivers comprehensive analysis and commentary covering the latest national and international news.

name: Cortes & Pellegrino
summary: Steve Cortes and Jenn Pellegrino fight for America First in Washington, the big media, and big business.

name: Top Chef: The Dish with Kish
summary: Kristen Kish hosts Top Chef: The Dish with Kish, a weekly show discussing Top Chef episodes, featuring guest chefs creating unique dishes inspired by challenges. Together, Kristen and her guests have fun cooking, eating, and revealing everything there is to know about Top Chef.

name: Оперативная память
summary: The experienced major Bagryshev jealously perceives the attachment of the young trainee Solomatin to him, thinking that his appearance will only bring retirement closer. However, the first symptoms of Alzheimer's further aggravate his situation — Bagryshev realizes that he will have to resign. Solomatin believes that the major is a real ace in the operational search, and it is from him that he must learn to become a first—class policeman. Therefore, he offers the new boss to conclude a contract: Bagryshev transfers all his experience and knowledge to him, and in return he becomes a kind of "RAM" for him, that is, he helps in every possible way and cleans up all his punctures. Bagryshev agrees. On the first day of working together, the partners discover corpses in the lake. The method of murder resembles the handwriting of a maniac whom Bagryshev shot during arrest several years ago. The major and the trainee will have to get to the truth in this complicated case, but they do not have much time, because important "files" are erased from the head of an experienced investigator.

name: This Is India
summary: The world's most populous nation is going to the polls.

name: The Media Show
summary: Social media, anti-social media, breaking news, faking news: this is the programme about a revolution in media.

name: My Sassy Girl
summary: Lu Nanyi, the daughter of a wealthy merchant in the capital, and Lin Qingqiu, the son of a distinguished family, grew up as childhood sweethearts despite their different social statuses, and their affection deepened over time. Ten years later, however, Lin Qingqiu was betrothed to someone else by his parents' arrangement, despite being in love with Lu Nanyi. The two planned to elope on the day of Lin Qingqiu's wedding, but they were tricked, and each received a farewell letter, leading them to mistakenly believe the other had abandoned them. Thus, they parted ways. A year later, Lin Qingqiu in pursuit of his lost love became the magistrate of Jinzhou County while Lu Nanyi became a famous storywriter. A shocking murder case in Jinzhou matched the plot in Lu Nanyi's stories, casting her under suspicion. As Lin Qingqiu took charge of the investigation, the former childhood sweethearts were reunited. Their old flame rekindled amidst the simmering tension as they "avenged" their past heartbreaks. But who is the real killer? Can their broken relationship be mended?

name: Australia's Best House
summary:
Australia's Best House is a celebration of the built form of the way we live in Australia. From display homes, multi- residential projects, brand new builds to breathtaking renovations, this show will take us inside the best residential projects in Australia. 

Australian model and actress Megan Gale guides us through the search as our three expert judges, architect Joe Snell, Interior Designer Briellyn Turton, and builder Andrew Purdie discuss and vote on which house has perfectly fit it's brief, exudes clever design and has been executed with excellence. Let's see if we can find Australia's Best House.

name: Phoenix Lands in the World
summary: Meng Xiao Tang is an internet-famous author who meets a sentimental reader that asks her to find her original intention of writing martial arts novels. She decides to amend a blood-thirsty novel, ""The Story of Nan Xi"", following a villainous heroine who cuts off her love for the sake of reaching the top. After randomly changing the plot for money which angered the online literary system, she was accidentally sent into the martial arts world she changed...

name: House Hunt Dilemma
summary: In "House Hunt Dilemma", amidst the excitement and dreams of future homeownership, couples can't agree on where this home should be. Hosts Ronnie and Georgia guide these couples.

name: Segunda muerte
summary:
'Segunda Muerte' is a thriller starring a police assistant, whose father is a recently retired UCO legend, who finds herself involved in a criminal investigation in a quiet Pasiego town.

In a small town in Cantabria, a young auxiliary police officer finds the body of an elderly lady who has recently passed away. The mystery lies in the fact that it is the body of Juliana Cobián, who had passed away seven years ago. Who was buried in her place, then? When Juliana's coffin is exhumed, another woman's body is found inside: it is Soledad's, Juliana's daughter that, according to all the neighbours, had left the town twenty years before. What lies behind this second death?

name: Huckabee Today
summary: As a complement to his long-running news and entertainment program on TBN, Huckabee will weigh in each day, cutting through the issues from the viewer point of view. Now Huckabee will be there to share his wisdom, his guiding hand. Don't we all want our children and grandchildren to live in a world that's even better than the one we grew up in?

name: The Ghost Files: Live with Vincente DiSanti
summary: A genre-focused podcast hosted by filmmaker Vincente DiSanti, spotlighting indie horror, slasher lore, and behind-the-scenes updates from Womp Stomp Films and the Jason Universe.

name: Only in Iola
summary: Newcomers and city slickers Perry, Shanalee, and Braydon Sharboneau have discovered the warmth of small-town living among the wonderful people in Iola, Texas. Most people have no clue about this tight-knit community, where 300 residents and 39 businesses call home. Join this family as they navigate their new way of living. Witness the power of faith, family and the strength of community as this extraordinary family trades, their lavish lifestyle for a simpler, more meaningful existence. Don't miss this heartwarming premiere of Only in Iola that will touch your soul.

name: Kururi: Who's in Love with Me?
summary: Makoto is a 24-year-old company employee who lives her life avoiding attention so as not to be disliked. But her life changes one night when an accident erases her memory! The only clue is a ring in her handbag she clearly meant for a man. When three men appear, one claiming to be her ex-lover, another her only male friend, and the third her soulmate, the mystery begins. Who is the ring for? And who is she? Makoto goes in search of true self and true love in this fun, romantic-comedy mystery.

name: My Name is Gabriel
summary: A program where you live 'the real life of that person' for 72 hours under the name of one of the world's 8 billion people in a place where no one knows you.

name: NewsNation Live With Connell McShane
summary: Connell McShane presents reports and analysis of the day's national and international newsworthy events.

name: En casa con Telemundo
summary: A mix of entertainment news, exclusives, live performances and more.

name: Beneath the Undertow
summary: In the former state-owned Xuri Factory, a woman with amputated feet is accidentally discovered in an abandoned sewage pool. The deceased is Shen Xiaozhou, the daughter of an employee. Lian Haiping, a middle-aged detective who is outwardly depressed but warm on the inside, and Shi Qiangfeng, an impetuous and hot-blooded rookie cop, unexpectedly become partners. Although they have gripes with each other, they must work together to find the real culprit. As they investigate one suspect after another, the two discover that behind the seemingly morally upright college student victim, there are many unexpected social aspects. Meanwhile, an old case that is deeply intertwined with the two people gradually surfaces. The relationship between Lian Haiping and Shi Qiangfeng becomes complicated because of "an old case" and "a past event." While the investigations are ongoing, cases of female households with amputated feet occur one after another, casting a shadow over the Xuri Factory that was once full of life. Lian Haiping also discovers that there is a force deliberately guiding the direction of the police investigation. As the fog seems to be clearing up, the undertow is already surging.

name: BBC News at 9am
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: BBC News at 2pm
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: La mesa caliente
summary: A team of bold and empowered women debate the most controversial topics.

name: BBC News at Midnight
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: BBC News at 1am
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: Hoy día
summary: The morning show that offers more entertainment, fun and information.

name: On Thin Ice: Putin v Greenpeace
summary: 2013: a daring protest on a Russian oil rig goes terrifyingly wrong. The activists become unwitting pawns in Putin's war against the West - and at the heart of a global crisis.

name: 2 Bears, 1 Cave
summary: Weekly, comedian best friends Tom Segura and Bert Kreischer get together in the bear cave at YMH Studios to do what bears do: make each other laugh.

name: The Fall: Skydive Murder Plot
summary: When a skydiver somehow survives the failure of both her parachutes, two dogged detectives uncover a story of affairs, debt, sex clubs, escorts and murderous intent.

name: Chao Neng Lifang
summary: An ordinary boy won the affection of his goddess and thus pissed off a gang leader. He got a mysterious cube accidentally and started his venture with superpowers. He grows in power as he helps people and punishes evildoers.

previousepisode.name: – Er det mulig å få et lite kyss?

name: Secrets of the Brain
summary: Neuroscientist Dr. Jack Lewis goes in search of people with unusual neurological conditions that give us a fascinating insight into how our brains work.

name: Igano Kabamaru
summary: After the death of Saizou, Kabamaru's horribly strict grandfather and Iga ninja teacher, an old lady, Ran Ookubo, claims that she received a letter from him asking her to take care of his grandson.

previousepisode.name: That One Day Which Is Called Sayonara Day

name: Acércate a Rocío
summary: Acércate a Rocío is a talk show in which host Rocío Sánchez Azuara invites guests to help them work out their personal problems. It's a show that truly strives to help people.

name: Dawaay El Safar
summary: Ibrahim lives in a world of his imagination; however, when he finds himself in a difficult situation, he decides to change his life with the help of his young neighbor, Ali.

name: Business Marriage
summary: Sayama Miyabi is a career-minded girl who got dumped by her boyfriend on their sixth anniversary. Just when she decides to live her life focusing on work, she meets Tsukasa, a CEO who wants to marry without romantic feelings for a reason. Tsukasa sees Miyabi's work-first attitude and proposes a business marriage, with the condition that they must divorce as soon as they develop romantic feelings for each other.

name: Alibi
summary: In the rural New Zealand community of Awatahi, a 17-year-old girl has been murdered. Now six suspects share their whereabouts on August 24th. Watch their interviews and delve into the world of Awatahi to figure out what really happened the day Jodie Hunter was killed.

name: Поймай меня, если сможешь
summary: A music and game TV show in which two teams compete: stars and participants. The first team consists of famous musicians, actors, presenters, composers and comedians, the second team includes TV viewers from different cities of Russia who love to sing, and not necessarily well. Participants perform musical numbers, which were carefully prepared in advance with experienced trainers and teachers. At the same time, they "sing" in other people's voices, to a soundtrack, hiding their real vocal abilities. The stars' task is to guess the participants who are deaf and cannot sing at all. Each episode features 18 viewers and four stars. Over the course of three rounds, both teams try to win one million rubles.

name: Cilada
summary: Bruno experiences day-to-day situations in which simple activities seem to go wrong.

name: Desde el Mañana
summary: Gabriela and Andrés, a doctor and a detective, must face a series of supernatural phenomena that disrupt their lives and those of their loved ones. Together, they have the opportunity to change their destinies.

name: O Jogo que Mudou a História
summary: Rio de Janeiro, late 1970s. A new agent starts working at the Ilha Grande prison, at the same time that a convict arrives at the institution on the coast of Rio. This is a time of effervescence for relationships within prison. Inspired by real events from the last 40 years, the story delves into the emergence of drug trafficking factions, based on events between the "Falange Jacaré" and "Turma do Fundão" wings of the prison. What happens inside has repercussions on the lives of Padre Nosso, Parada Geral and Morro da Promessa, communities inspired by real favelas.

name: Ja, sa brura
summary: Jon Martin Henriksen, Erik Follestad, Ida Fladen and Mads Hansen take on their biggest mission to date, when they promise to arrange a wedding from A to Z.

name: Noticias Telemundo mediodía
summary: A news program with a unique style of telling news in an attractive way. Local and national stories are presented, from different angles of events, and interviews.

name: The Panorama Interviews with Nick Robinson
summary: Nick Robinson interviews the major party leaders in the run-up to the general election.

name: Walking with Dinosaurs
summary: In an exciting reimagining of one of the BBC's best loved factual shows, each episode of Walking with Dinosaurs tells the dramatic story of an individual dinosaur whose remains are currently being unearthed by the world's leading dinosaur hunters. Thanks to cutting-edge science, experts can work out how these prehistoric creatures lived, hunted, fought and died more accurately than ever before. As the dinosaur's bones emerge from the ground, the series bring these prehistoric stories to life with state-of-the-art visual effects - making each episode a gripping dinosaur drama based on the very latest evidence.

previousepisode.name: Walking With Dinosaurs: A Viewer's Guide

name: Nadiya's Cook Once, Eat Twice
summary: In this crafty cookery series, beloved TV chef Nadiya Hussain is back on our screens and this time she's showing the country how you can make your ingredients stretch further than you could ever imagine by sharing recipes that align with her philosophy ‘cook once and eat twice'. We will see Nadiya spinning leftovers into exciting and genuinely new recipes that make eating something for the second time as enticing as the first; rustling up convenient batch friendly bakes and treats to eat now and freeze/store for later; or turning otherwise-wasted-ingredients into thrilling new meals encouraging us to make the most of every second we spend in the kitchen.

name: Back from the Dead: Who Kidnapped Me?
summary:
Back from the Dead: Who Kidnapped Me? follows the kidnapping of Delimar Vera, an extraordinary true story that shocked America two decades ago. For the first time, Delimar sits down to exclusively tell the world her truth. At just 10 days old, Delimar was originally reported dead in a tragic housefire, even though her body was not found. Six years later, her mother Luz Cuevas spotted a young girl at a birthday party who looked exactly like she had as a child - incredibly this was Delimar, six years old and perfectly healthy. 

Across three episodes, Back from the Dead: Who Kidnapped Me? will explore all the twists and turns that saw Delimar reunited with her mother and how the unanswered questions around her kidnapping, who helped her kidnapper, and her miraculous return have affected her family, her life and her future - in Delimar's own words.

name: Lies, Deceit and Betrayal
summary: Lies, Deceit and Betrayal tells the stories of the most audacious scams in recent history, scams that anyone could fall for. In each episode, viewers are introduced to a different devious criminal who went to great lengths to con their victims and ruin lives in the process. From romance fraudsters to health scammers, the stories are told through first-person testimony.

name: Candis Cayne's Secret Garden
summary: Candis Cayne's Secret Garden is a gardening show unlike any other. Trailblazing actress and style icon Candis Cayne welcomes us into her "Secret Garden": a backyard paradise filled with plants, flowers, and magical friends. From her playful and imaginative world, Candis inspires us to create our own enchanted gardens with DIY projects, backyard makeovers, gardening tips and tricks, and inventive botanical cocktails. Each episode of Candis Cayne's Secret Garden is designed to make gardening accessible to all... even those of us with green thumbs.

previousepisode.name: Let Them Eat Cake: A Secret Garden Wedding

name: Breakfast with Anna Jones
summary: All the big stories of the morning, with news making interviews, human interest stories, newspaper review and the latest sports update.

name: Stakelbeck Tonight
summary: From wars and rumors of war abroad to the rise of anti-Christian, "woke" ideology here at home, it's clear that Americans are living in perilous and unprecedented times. Some would even say that we're witnessing Bible prophecy unfold in real time. Stakelbeck Tonight makes sense of these stunning developments through a bold and biblical lens. Each night, host Erick Stakelbeck takes viewers around the world—from Jerusalem to London to Washington, D.C., and points beyond—with cutting edge commentary, analysis and interviews focusing on these world-changing events and why it all matters to you. Stakelbeck Tonight shines a light in the darkness and reminds viewers that even in these uncertain times, God is still in control and has a great plan for His Church.

name: Sky News at 10am
summary: A summary of the latest news headlines.

name: Cilada
summary: Bruno lives different situations in which everything goes wrong. Trips with friends, barbecues, relationships on social media and even looking for a job turn into real pitfalls.

name: The Count
summary: Newsmax counts up the top stories of the week, while offering analysis by lawmakers, newsmakers, and policy experts.

name: L'Agent Jean!
summary: At the heart of the First Continent, an ultra-giga-secret organization called the Agency is responsible for protecting Earth A and its population of super villains with ideas and ambitions, each more demonic than the last! The Agency counts among its ranks the famous Agent Jean. The latter, who succeeds in everything without always knowing why, must constantly save Earth A from an imminent catastrophe!

name: What the Love! with Karan Johar
summary: With help from celebrity guests and a glam squad, filmmaker Karan Johar mentors six singletons through their personal struggles as they look for love.

name: Adult Kids
summary: A hyper-realistic drama depicting the daily lives of clumsy women in their 30s in the fashion industry and their joys and sorrows at work.

name: Naked Attraction España
summary: A dating show that begins where some dates may end: naked. Singles get up close and personal as they meet for the first time.

name: Grendizer U
summary: Duke Fleed is a survivor of the Fleed Planet who is escaped to the Earth, onboard a mysterious "spaceship", where is raised by Dr. Umon as his adoptive son, and known as Daisuke Umon. Years after his arrival, he's faced with the threat of King Vega and his army, who want to conquer the Earth. With his friends Koji and Hikaru (and later his younger sister Maria Grace), Duke decides to fight back using his best weapon - the almighty Grendizer.

previousepisode.name: In the Name of the beautiful Earth

name: Crocadoo
summary: The crazy world of Crocadoo is thrown into chaos when plans for a new hotel are drawn up. The crocodiles are forced to live in half the area they had before and they want their land back.

name: SolarBalls
summary: What if we could see the universe from a different perspective? If we weren't limited by Earth's gravity and could just fly through space and see planets up close? Well... we'll probably freak out when we notice they have a face!

previousepisode.name: Triton and Callisto Go on a Date - Part 1

nextepisode.name: Triton and Callisto Go on a Date - Part 2

name: L'armure de Jade
summary: Jade is a legendary superhero. And now it's up to Lan Jun to wear her armor... hard to believe it's her turn to don the famous Jade armor and use her kung fu skills to fight evil! With the help of her friends, Theo and Alisha, as well as the Beasticons, the legendary servants of the armor, Lan Jun must fight against super villains and manage her teenage life.

name: Mafias & Banks
summary:
Mafias and Banks: two opposite worlds. They share the same taste for luxury, risk, and easy money yet they despise and fear each other and both have connections to the government.

For a long time, criminals robbed banks, ripping them open and emptying their safes. It wasn't until the end of the Second World War that the mafias realized just how much profit they could make from banking institutions, and later from finance.

name: Одна родина
summary: Oksana, without warning anyone, returns home from Poland. Parents did not expect to see their daughter. On the field, the girl's father meets his old enemy, and Oksana sees her classmate Maxim in the car. A friend persuades a girl to go to the Ivan Kupala holiday, which was organized by her father's enemy. But they do not yet know that on the holiday ardent love will be born and family feuds will be renewed, and the most terrible thing will happen - war will come to their homes.

name: Невістка
summary: Brave and hardworking guy Kostya meets Olga, the banker's daughter. Her father is categorically against the marriage of his daughter with a boy who is not from their circle. In order to win the favor of the chosen one's parents, Kostya seeks to gain status and wealth, so he leaves the city. Meanwhile, the son of the regional prosecutor begins courting his beloved. When Kostya returns to his hometown to be with Olga, he falls into a whirlpool of dangerous events and intrigues.

name: A Hero
summary: Qin Chuan, a rookie cop, joins a special task force and is sent on an undercover mission to the Golden Triangle. After stepping in as the lead agent, he infiltrates the cartel to uncover vital intelligence and tries to prevent the cartel from setting up a drug factory on the mainland.

name: Making It in Manhattan
summary: Making It in Manhattan is an unscripted series that follows a tight-knit group of friends in New York City as they navigate the trials and triumphs of young adulthood.

name: On Safari
summary: On Safari is set in the heart of the South African Bush and explores the spectacular world of the most luxurious safari experiences, and the international group of guides who create once-in-a-lifetime moments for their adventure seeking clientele.

name: The Truth
summary:
On the day the most controversial murder case in Israel is to be given a highly anticipated final verdict, 10 years later, another identical murder takes place. A copycat killer? A hit ordered by the man convicted for the first case, from prison? The original murderer who was actually never caught?

With only two weeks for the police to present its findings to the judges while the first verdict is on hold, young detective Racheli Zabatani must revisit the past, the events that changed her life and the old case her own father investigated, in order to figure out the mysteries of the present: this new murder case, as well as her own personal quest.

Partly inspired by true events.

name: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
summary: England. 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths — the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent — to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

name: Fjellhytta
summary: Four participant couples will fight for eight weeks to win their own cabin in the mountains. Every week they have to go through extensive renovations and competitions.

name: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai
summary: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of 5 extra-terrestrial people, from a different galaxy. They have come to earth in search of their lost son. These 5 aliens consist of a father, mother and their 3 children. Few years back they had lost their youngest son while travelling through our galaxy. Since then they have been searching for him from planet to planet.This hunt of theirs had got them to our planet earth.

name: Полупановы
summary: Spouses Igor Yurich and Tatiana, as well as their son Federico Polupanov, are not an ordinary family. They live in their own universe, where you can dig a hole without a shovel, have lunch without food and escape from prison without getting into it. Therefore, when Natalia, a social worker, appears on the doorstep, the Polupanovs refuse the offer to move to more comfortable conditions under the state renovation program — they feel good here. Since the Polupanovs are absolutely not interested in money, Natalia uses any methods that will help to relocate the family: from fictional ghosts in the house and inviting guardianship authorities to organizing a revolt of the village against the Polupanovs. But the desperate attempts of the social worker to free up the living space are broken every time by new oddities of the family.

name: Au Pairs
summary: Four young people leave for the adventure of a lifetime: they work as an au pair for three months. In addition to the daily care of children, they all pursue their own dreams and desires. How do they survive far from their familiar environment?

name: Melissa Etheridge: I'm Not Broken
summary: Melissa Etheridge: I'm Not Broken tells an inspiring story of healing and transcendence through the power of music when five female residents from the Topeka Correctional Facility, a women's prison in Kansas, write letters to Etheridge that she then uses as inspiration to create and perform an original song for them. Having recently lost her son to opioids, Etheridge works to understand and interrupt the cycle of addiction while connecting with these women who, so often, are forgotten by society.

name: Chinook: Zulu Delta 576
summary: 1994. A horrific helicopter crash in the Mull of Kintyre wipes out Northern Ireland's top intelligence personnel. The pilots are blamed - and a fight for truth and justice begins.

name: Let Wind Go By
summary: In 2003, when a small mining town in Ningxia faced relocation, a burned female corpse was discovered outside the police station. The circumstances of her death bore a striking resemblance to a brutal unsolved case from a decade earlier. Veteran detective Zhu Zhiqiang, nearing retirement, teamed up with Zhang Tao, who had been transferred to the mining town's criminal investigation unit due to a work-related mistake. Together, they worked to unravel the case, uncovering the tragic truths buried in the town's past as the relocation unfolded.

name: Limitless Skies
summary: The story revolves around an ordinary youth named Ye Fan who gets pulled into a strangle unknown world and embarks on a wondrous adventure.

name: The Limbo
summary: s the New Year approaches, a sudden subsidence accident occurred at Luobai Department Store, a long-established shopping mall in Haizhou City, trapping 13 people underground. This race between time and life brings many tests of human nature, morality and faith...

name: The Unclouded Soul
summary: The story centers on the conflict between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan over the mystical Yuli Divine Spring. A free-spirited young girl, Xiao Yao, accidentally enters the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons, triggering a chain of turmoil and drawing her into a series of mysterious cases alongside Hong Ye, the Demon King. Having witnessed the depths of desire and ambition, Hong Ye discovers that Xiao Yao possesses a pure heart untouched by worldly greed.The two uncover the hidden truth behind the struggle surrounding the Yuli Divine Spring.

name: Shadow Love
summary: Li Shuang, a female general of Taijin, takes in an amnesiac man she found by chance, and names him Jin An. An accompanies Shuang wholeheartedly, and the two secretly fall in love. However, when An remembers that he is actually the prince of an enemy state, the two devoted lovers have no choice but to take up arms against each other. Jaded of war, they decide to join forces to resolve the crisis and uphold justice.

name: Alto Astral
summary: Two doctor brothers compete for the love of the same woman. The plot involving this love triangle is full of evil, betrayal, past lives, adoption and love.

name: Denise Richards and Her Wild Things
summary: Denise Richards and Her Wild Things will follow Richards, her husband Aaron Phypers and her daughters Sami, Lola and Eloise.

name: Yuan Zun
summary: A young man with his brush plunges into a chaotic world and lights up the heavens. In a world where cultivators are paramount, will the vermilion bird swallow the dragon, or will the dragon transcend beyond all else?

name: Заезжий молодец
summary:
Larisa is a strong woman who has long been accustomed to dealing with any problems on her own. She alone raises a difficult teenage son, earns her living through hard work, and has long despaired of finding personal happiness.
Larisa's neighbor, wanting to take possession of her house, brings the heroine together with her nephew Oleg, a narrow-minded martinet. Tired of endless loneliness, Larisa tries to build a relationship with him, but the conspiracy is soon revealed...
Suddenly, Larisa witnesses how the police detain an undocumented man on the street. Having warmed up to the stranger, the heroine helps him free and pays a fine for him. The next day, the rescued man appears at her house, but not at all to repay the debt - he asks Larisa for an overnight stay. In anger, the heroine drives him away, but subsequent events radically change the woman's attitude towards this man, who appeared so strangely in her life...

name: AYAKA is in LOVE with HIROKO
summary: Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other.

previousepisode.name: I'll never treat you like a stranger

name: I Hear the Sunspot
summary: The story starts with college student Taichi, who comes from a not-so-well-off household and is desperately searching for work. He (literally) stumbles across fellow student Kouhei while on a job hunt, and is incredibly enticed by the delicious bento Kouhei has in hand. However, something seems a bit off about Kouhei and when Taichi consults his friends about it, he gets an answer he really wasn't expecting: Kouhei is severely hearing impaired.

name: Fake Buddies
summary: Fake male and female friend finally meet.

previousepisode.name: I made a 'last confession' to my best friend

name: Little Disasters
summary: Little Disasters centers on four friends who were thrown together while expectant mothers with little in common apart from their due dates. When Jess takes her baby daughter to hospital with a head injury she can't explain, close friend and on-duty A&E doctor Liz is forced to make the excruciating decision as to whether to call social services on her friend. The decision sets of a chain of events that show how a moment can fracture and nearly destroy families and friendships.

name: Forbidden Love
summary: Forbidden Love follows four couples deeply in love who must come to terms with the one major hurdle complicating their relationships — religion. Hailing from different faiths, one partner from each couple is converting or has decided to relinquish their family-of-origin and culture entirely. Facing such intense traditional differences, can their relationships endure the trials of converting or will their love falter under the pressure? A compelling exploration of the ties that bind.
